title: Lab Rat
tagline: A first-person night shift in a research annex gone wrong: a pipe wrench, three alien species, and a notebook of how they behave.
readinessNote: One complete test level (5 to 10 minutes) with checkpoints, a scripted run from the lab to the freight lift and an end card. Rooms, doors, props, lights and pickups are data in src/map.mjs, but that file holds exactly one level and the beats are scripted in src/main.mjs by room id; a second level means turning map.mjs into a list of levels and moving the beats into data first.
buildYourOwn: Rooms, doors, props, pickups and lights; creature placements; field-note observations; new creatures (procedural body in models.mjs, behaviour in creatures.mjs).
controls: Keyboard and mouse (WASD, mouse look, pointer lock)
